definitions.gloss: lakeside; lakeshore; shore of a lake
definitions.explanation: The area along the edge of a lake. Often associated with scenic views, resorts, and recreational activities.

examples.japanese: {湖畔|こはん}でキャンプをした。
{湖畔|こはん}のホテルに{泊|と}まった。
examples.english: I stayed at a lakeside hotel.

examples.japanese: {静|しず}かな{湖畔|こはん}を{散歩|さんぽ}しながら、{鳥|とり}の{声|こえ}を{聞|き}いた。
examples.english: While strolling along the quiet lakeshore, I listened to the birdsong.

notes:
USAGE:
A somewhat literary word often used in travel writing and scenic descriptions. {湖畔|こはん} evokes a peaceful, natural setting and is commonly associated with vacation spots and resort areas.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {湖畔|こはん}のホテル (lakeside hotel)
- {湖畔|こはん}を{散歩|さんぽ}する (to stroll along the lake)
- {湖畔|こはん}に{建|た}つ (to stand by the lake)
- {湖畔|こはん}でキャンプする (to camp by the lake)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {湖岸|こがん}: lakeshore — more technical, used in geography
- {岸辺|きしべ}: shore, waterside — can refer to any body of water
- {畔|ほとり}: beside, edge — poetic/literary term for the edge of water
